name: Dienst ~Hakoniwa no Mesu Dorei-tachi~
source:
Main character is invited to a mansion of his never acquainted father. Protagonist receives a condition to train four maids within a week and fulfill certain criteria in order to receive the inheritance.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被邀请前往素未谋面的父亲的宅邸。他接到的条件是：在一周内调教四名女仆并满足特定标准，才能获得遗产继承权。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
